title: Python Agent Migration Phase 4: Port NL Editor Agent Loop, Commons Agent, and AI Generators

sections.what: Port the remaining browser AI loops (nl-editor/agent-loop.ts, tools.ts, budget.ts, staging.ts, diff.ts, commons/commons-agent.ts, shared/ai-generator.ts, shared/embedding-client.ts) into Python using engine/agent/llm_client.py, leaving only UI components in TypeScript.
sections.why: Completes the separation of concerns so zero LLM orchestration or tool loops remain in browser TypeScript.
sections.how:
1. Port NL Editor tool loop and staging/diff logic to Python behind Flask endpoints.
2. Port Commons agent loop and AI generation helpers to engine/agent/.
3. Keep nl-editor/ui.ts, ghosts.ts, and commons-ui.ts as thin browser views.
sections.verify: NL Editor staging/diff and Commons agent turns pass Python unit tests and work live in the browser UI.

acceptance.text: NL Editor tool loop and diffing run in Python.
Commons agent loop and AI generators run in Python via engine/agent/llm_client.py.
Browser retains only UI views and interaction handlers.

custom.browser_ui: In the NL Editor and Commons UI, verify staged diffs, ghost previews, and generated content render and apply cleanly with zero console errors.
